deep_research.notes: States Ganderbal. Several citations point at the wrong page: the ecovillage.org page has no address, the ecoideaz page has no 6 km distance, and the casaclan page mentions neither Harmukh nor coordinates. The address and the 6 km figure do appear on other pages, but not on the ones cited. Mapcarta supports only the coordinates. Zeenews and Precious Kashmir support the founder and the farm food, but neither page text says 'first eco village'. Answer Z lists 7 claims; the 11 entries above are claim-URL pairs.
